title: BIA.----EXT.FT.
description: Second diagram on page 445 (TRF(CW)-17), paired with (R)PART x TR above. The crossing diagrams how bi-aitionalism structurally meets extended-functionalism at the creative-women improvised-music essence-factor scale: BIA crossed with EXT-FT. BIA sits centrally with the subject-arrow; EXT-FT at lower-left as partner-axis. Three lines leave the main line. TRS (transition) rises from it and carries VT-PLT (vibrational platform), which carries ALT-DEF (alternative definitions), which carries PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). TR-INFO (trans-information) runs to the left and carries COS-P (cosmic particulars). AFI (affinity insight) runs to the right and carries SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics), which branches to UFI-PI and to RIT-DY (ritual dynamics); INFO-DE(B) (information degrees) branches from the RIT-DY line.
